name: Gra☆Mana
source:
My name is Chihiro. I am a l*lita-esque model in the "pretty-young-girl" division.
Lately, I'm having a little problem because there were so much works involved in the extreme costumes and poses.

But, to tell you the truth, I'm quite happy about it because I have someone special. I want him to see my pictures.

A father pleasures himself by looking at his daughter's photograph. A daughter fantasizes about the forbidden love with her father. The love and sexual desire that crossed the father-daughter boundary...

Step-father focused SIDE-A and SIDE-B which focuses on the daughter.

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042120.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫千寻，是“美少女”部门一名萝＊莉风格的模特。
最近有点伤脑筋，要穿特别露骨的服装、摆大胆姿势的工作实在太多了。

不过说老实话，我还挺开心的，因为我心里有一个特别的人。我想让他看见我的照片。

父亲看着女儿的照片自慰。女儿幻想着与父亲的禁忌之恋。超越父女界限的爱与性欲…

A面以继父为主角，B面则聚焦于女儿。
